VTC_F_OPERATIONAL_READINESS_AUDIT.scope: operator_access deployment docs + SSE e2e test plan

require_operator_access.description: Localhost bypass for GET /latest and GET /stream. Non-local requires X-Brain-Token if BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN is set.

require_strict_operator_access.description: NO localhost bypass. Requires BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN env var AND matching X-Brain-Token header.

restart_brain_v9_safe.ps1.description: Does NOT set BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN in launch environment.
restart_brain_v9_safe.ps1.risk: POST /brain/agent-trace/event fails with 403 'strict operator token not configured' unless operator configures token manually.

BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Env var read at runtime via os.getenv('BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN'). Not hardcoded. Not logged. Supports hmac compare_digest.
BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN.exposure_risk: LOW (never logged, never hardcoded, only compared via compare_digest)
BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN.deployment_gap: No docs exist explaining how operator should configure this token.

X-Brain-Token.description: HTTP header required for StrictOperatorAccess. Expected to match BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN env var.
X-Brain-Token.security: Compared via hmac.compare_digest to prevent timing attacks.

risks_identified.description: POST /brain/agent-trace/event unusable in production without manual BRAIN_ADMIN_TOKEN configuration.
risks_identified.mitigation: Create operator runbook documenting token setup.

risks_identified.description: GET /latest and GET /stream allow localhost bypass — acceptable for local operator UI but risky if exposed to network.
No deployment documentation for operator_access token exists.

test_infrastructure.httpx_policy: Forbidden in many modules for security. TestClient from fastapi.testclient is acceptable.
test_infrastructure.recommended_approach: FastAPI TestClient streaming response for SSE endpoint. Inject event via _emit_agent_trace_internal to avoid token requirement. Assert redaction markers present and raw secrets absent.

risks_identified.description: No automated SSE test verifies redaction in streamed events.

recommended_patch_sequence: VTC-F1: Create operator_access runbook docs (docs/ or tmp_agent/visual_trace_console_v1/)
VTC-F2: Create SSE e2e automated test (tests/unit/test_agent_trace_sse_e2e.py)
VTC-E (optional): UI operator polish after operational readiness secured
